result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian access with sidewalks and curb ramps, but suffers from faded crosswalk markings and poor pavement quality. The environment is primarily designed for vehicle throughput, lacking dedicated pedestrian signals or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The corner design allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway and crossing area creates potential trip hazards.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental-style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks in a residential area. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and potential sightline obstructions from corner vegetation present risks.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree on the corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway width without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and overhead traffic signals within a residential row-house context. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near corners may create visibility challenges and long crossing distances.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on the far side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalks.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians further into the street before they cross.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalks to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features wide multi-lane roadways with marked zebra crosswalks but lacks pedestrian refuge islands or visible dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is dominated by vehicle-centric design with long crossing distances and minimal traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: The zebra crosswalk markings are worn and may be less visible to approaching drivers, especially in low light.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible at this signalized intersection, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.
